Why BK Studio

We build for real businesses, not just portfolios

Most web agencies build websites that look great in screenshots but don't actually bring in customers. We focus on what matters: your website needs to work — on mobile, on slow connections, and for people who've never heard of you before.

Based in Bali, we understand the local market. We've built for surf schools, tattoo studios, merch brands, and service businesses across the island — and we treat every project like it's our own business.

How It Works

Simple. Fast.
No tech headache.

01

Consultation

We chat on WhatsApp to understand your business, what you need, and what you want your website to do. No jargon.

02

Proposal & Quote

You get a clear breakdown — what's included, how much it costs, and how long it takes. No hidden fees.

03

Build & Review

We build your site and show you drafts along the way. You give feedback. We refine until it's perfect.

04

Launch & Support

Your website goes live. We handle deployment and stick around for any questions or updates after launch.
